description: What the AI may not do in this repository. Source of truth: sync.py turns it into .claude/settings.json and .codex/rules, and the guard hook enforces it before every tool call. Format modelled on agent-perms (tool / pattern / tier); "unless" lists tool-name globs exempt from a rule (e.g. drafts).
